properties.title: Kyiv ballistic strikes (Ukraine Independence Day)
properties.summary: Russia struck Kyiv and Boryspil airport twice in 24h with ballistic missiles on/before Ukraine's 35th Independence Day. ~10 world leaders in Kyiv.

properties.title: Kharkiv outskirts attack
properties.summary: Russian attacks on Kharkiv outskirts killed 3 people late Aug 23, 8 others rescued.

properties.title: Ukraine frontline thermal cluster (FIRMS)
properties.summary: Multiple FIRMS thermal anomalies near Donetsk frontline, FRP 2-3 MW each.

properties.title: FIRMS thermal anomaly near Sumy border (Bryansk)
properties.summary: VIIRS anomaly at 51.97N 34.14E, FRP 2.73 MW near Sumy/Bryansk border area.

properties.title: Conakry landfill landslide, Guinea
properties.summary: Heavy rains triggered landslide at Dar Es Salam landfill in Conakry. 30 killed, 6 seriously injured. Shacks buried.

properties.title: Japan M6.0 earthquake
properties.summary: GDACS green magnitude 6.0 earthquake in Japan, Aug 23. 1.9 million in MMI>=IV.

properties.title: Scotia Sea M6.2
properties.summary: GDACS green M6.2 earthquake, Scotia Sea, depth 10km, Aug 22. No population affected reported.

properties.title: US naval blockade of Iran - Strait of Hormuz
properties.summary: US maintains naval blockade. 22-night pause on strikes. ~85 vessels intercepted. Ceasefire technically holds. 90% Polymarket probability ceasefire continues through Aug 31.

properties.title: Brazil: presidential election Oct 4
properties.summary: Lula vs Flavio Bolsonaro statistical tie in polls. Renan Santos 3% Polymarket. Runoff Oct 25 if no majority.

properties.title: Shein Hong Kong IPO
properties.summary: Shein launches HK IPO at $27bn valuation ($1.77bn raise). Largest HK IPO of 2026. Trading begins Sept 1.
